system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 3

(You must have Latent 1s and 0s II) Beginning at 11th level, you can attempt to make a keycard of a specific rank by rolling a Ninshou check vs. a DC equal to 8 + the rank selected (E-Rank: 4, D-Rank: 7, C-Rank: 11, B-Rank: 15, A-Rank: 19, S-Rank: 23). On a success, you spend 2 chakra die and create a keycard that can open a number of doors, equal to or less than the rank of the keycard chosen, a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus, before dispersing. The doors need not be technology to be opened with the keycard. You can do this twice per long rest.
